affinity.description:
InfluxDB(TM) Core Affinity for pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/#affinity-and-anti-affinity
Note: podAffinityPreset, podAntiAffinityPreset, and  nodeAffinityPreset will be ignored when it's set

apiVersions.description: Override Kubernetes API versions reported by .Capabilities

args.description: Override default container args (useful when using custom images)

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount Service Account token in pod

azure.description:
Microsoft Azure configuration (ignored unless `objectStore` is set to `azure`)
Microsoft Azure credentials

bucket.description: Name of the bucket to create (only when using a Cloud Provider for object storage)

command.description: Override default container command (useful when using custom images)

exampleValue.description:
bitnami/common
It is required by CI/CD tools and processes.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to all deployed objects

commonLabels.description: Labels to add to all deployed objects

databases.description: Comma separated list of databases to create (ignored if `objectStore` is set to `memory`)

extraContainerPorts.description:
Optionally specify extra list of additional ports for InfluxDB(TM) Core nodes
e.g:
extraContainerPorts:
- name: myservice
containerPort: 9090
InfluxDB(TM) Core pods' resource requests and limits
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-compute-resources-container/

extraDeploy.description: Array of extra objects to deploy with the release

extraEnvVars.description: Array with extra environment variables to add InfluxDB(TM) Core nodes

extraEnvVarsCM.description: Name of existing ConfigMap containing extra env vars for InfluxDB(TM) Core nodes

extraEnvVarsSecret.description: Name of existing Secret containing extra env vars for InfluxDB(TM) Core nodes

extraVolumeMounts.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumeMounts for the InfluxDB(TM) Core pods

extraVolumes.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumes for the InfluxDB(TM) Core pods

google.description:
Google Cloud Storage configuration (ignored unless `objectStore` is set to `google`)
Google Cloud credentials

initContainers.description:
Add additional init-containers to the InfluxDB(TM) Core pod(s)
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/
e.g:
initContainers:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "hello world"']
InfluxDB(TM) Core Pod Disruption Budget configuration
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb

initdbScripts.description:
Dictionary of initdb scripts
Alternatively, you can put your scripts under the files/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d directory
initdbScripts:
my_init_script.sh: |
!/bin/sh
echo "Do something."

initdbScriptsCM.description: Name of existing ConfigMap object with the initdb scripts (`initdbScripts` will be ignored).

initdbScriptsSecret.description: Secret with initdb scripts that contain sensitive information (Note: can be used with `initdbScriptsConfigMap` or `initdbScripts`)

lifecycleHooks.description: for the InfluxDB(TM) Core container(s) to automate configuration before or after startup

nodeSelector.description:
InfluxDB(TM) Core Node labels for pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/

persistence.description:
Enable persistence using Persistent Volume Claims
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/

podAffinityPreset.description:
InfluxDB(TM) Core Pod affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podAnnotations.description:
Annotations for InfluxDB(TM) Core pods
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

podAntiAffinityPreset.description:
InfluxDB(TM) Core Pod anti-affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podLabels.description:
Extra labels for InfluxDB(TM) Core pods
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

replicaCount.description: Number of InfluxDB(TM) Core replicas (ignored if `objectStore` is set to `file` or `memory`)

resources.description:
Set container requests and limits for different resources like CPU or memory (essential for production workloads)
Example:
resources:
requests:
cpu: 2
memory: 512Mi
limits:
cpu: 3
memory: 1024Mi
Configure InfluxDB(TM) Core pods Security Context
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-pod

resourcesPreset.description:
Set container resources according to one common preset (allowed values: none, nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge). This is ignored if resources is set (resources is recommended for production).
More information: https://github.com/bitnami/charts/blob/main/bitnami/common/templates/_resources.tpl#L15

revisionHistoryLimit.description: InfluxDB(TM) Core deployment revision history limit

s3.description:
AWS S3 configuration (ignored unless `objectStore` is set to `s3`)
AWS S3 credentials

schedulerName.description:
Name of the k8s scheduler (other than default)
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/configure-multiple-schedulers/

sidecars.description:
Add additional sidecar containers to the InfluxDB(TM) Core pod(s)
e.g:
sidecars:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
ports:
- name: portname
containerPort: 1234

tolerations.description:
InfluxDB(TM) Core Tolerations for pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/taint-and-toleration/

topologySpreadConstraints.description:
Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/
The value is evaluated as a template

useHelmHooks.description: Enable use of Helm hooks if needed, e.g. on pre-install jobs

usePasswordFiles.description:
Mount credentials as files instead of using environment variables
Diagnostic mode
